insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen; not applied where hospital doesn't follow differential billing

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of sum insured; no specific daily cap mentioned in policy wording

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy

sub_limits.display: Cataract, cardiac devices, modern treatments capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹30k-₹40k/eye depending on SI; Cardiac devices: up to 50% of SI; Modern treatments: procedure-wise sub-limits; Coronary angiogram: ₹20k-₹25k; Heart transplant: up to 200% of SI; Pain management: procedure-wise sub-limits; Rehabilitation: up to 10% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Section 1 (non-cardiac): 30-day waiting period for illnesses; Section 2 (cardiac): 30-day waiting period from first commencement; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Section 1 non-cardiac PED: 36 months; Section 2 cardiac PED: only 30 days waiting period applies

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to Section 1 only for listed conditions including cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, varicose veins, prostate, transplants, etc. Heart transplantation under Section 2 also has 24-month disease-specific waiting period

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded under Exclusion Code Excl 18

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of basic SI per claim-free year; max 100% of basic SI; reduced proportionately on claim; not applicable for Section 3 OPD

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of 100% of basic SI once per policy period upon exhaustion; only for Section 1 (non-cardiac); cannot be used for same illness, modern treatments, or cardiac ailments; unutilized restored SI cannot be carried forward

pre_hosp.note: Applicable for both Section 1 and Section 2

post_hosp.note: Applicable for both Section 1 and Section 2

day_care.note: All day care procedures covered under both Section 1 and Section 2

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in the policy

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to sum insured under both Section 1 and Section 2; Yoga and Naturopathy subject to prior company approval

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned; transplant surgery itself covered under Section 2 for heart transplantation

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance covered when medically necessary; no specific rupee cap stated in policy wording

modern_treatments.note: Covered for both Section 1 and Section 2 but subject to procedure-wise sub-limits per policy period (e.g. Robotic surgery ₹2.5L-₹4L, Deep Brain Stimulation ₹2.5L-₹4L, Oral Chemo ₹1.25L-₹2.5L, etc.)

consumables.note: Consumables are listed as items subsumed into room/procedure charges but not separately covered; no consumables rider available

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to within India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment; coverage not available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI portability guidelines apply; must apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, infertility, cosmetic surgery, hazardous sports, EECP/chelation therapy, chondrocyte implantation, PRP injections, circumcision, congenital external defects

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons mentioned in the policy wording; wellness reward program offers up to 10% premium discount on renewal
